data.title: Unit 8 : Matter and material
How much you know?
data.text: Click the correct option for each of these statements.
Boiling speeds up the process of evaporation.
Freezing is the opposite of melting.
The freezing point of a substance is different from its melting point in the solid state.
The melting point of water is 100°C.
Liquids start evaporating well below their boiling points.

feedback.wrong1: Oh no! That's not correct. Please try again.
feedback.rank1: Hmm... You can do better than this.
